notesPrepared.zh-Hans:
维珀 0.1.0（6）内部测试

新增支持设备的可用内存权限；普通内存警告先回收缓存，持续内存不足时仍会停止任务。
从灵感开始创作时，将当前完整造型参数带入 AI，保持已选结构和材质的上下文。
收到完整造型参数后及时结束生成；未完成的结果仍会明确提示。
预览取消不再作为最终加载错误显示，重新进入页面可重新加载。
作品库使用每件已保存模型自己的真实缩略图，预览失败不会损坏已保存作品。

请重点测试：选择灵感后生成、取消后再次生成、预览重新进入、保存并打开作品、作品库缩略图。

继续使用同一份 Qwen3.5 4B INT4 素材，本机 AI 需要 12GB 或以上内存。复杂题材的结构、细节与成功率仍处于早期，可能失败或需要手动编辑。本次不承诺全面修复 AI 造型质量。首次 Apple 素材下载和离线使用仍需实机验证；不以 Mac 测试速度代表手机速度。
notesPrepared.en-US:
Voxamber 0.1.0 (6), internal test

Adds the supported-device memory entitlement. Ordinary memory warnings reclaim caches first; sustained low memory can still stop a task.
Starting from an inspiration now supplies its full current shape parameters to AI, preserving the selected structure and material context.
Generation stops when a complete parameter object has arrived; incomplete output still reports a failure.
Canceled preview loading no longer appears as a final loading error. Returning to the page can reload it.
The library uses real thumbnails of each saved model. A preview failure cannot damage saved work.

Please test generating from an inspiration, canceling and generating again, reopening previews, saving/reopening work, and library thumbnails.

Uses the same Qwen3.5 4B INT4 assets. On-device AI requires at least 12 GB RAM. Complex subject structure, detail and success rate remain early and may fail or need manual editing. This build does not promise a comprehensive modeling-quality fix. First-time Apple asset download and offline use still need phone verification; Mac timings are not phone speed claims.
